# Luis Cabrera

From product management to software engineering to agentic engineering. Building products with AI.

Global reach, based in Warsaw.

- GitHub: https://github.com/luisecab
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/luisecab/
- Website: https://www.luiscabrera.me/

## About

I'm a product-minded software engineer at P&G, based in Warsaw, Poland. My career started in Mexico, working across operations and product at FREENOW, Mercado Libre, and Foxtrot Systems. I later joined P&G as a product manager, working on Pampers' global CRM and messaging ecosystem.

In 2025, I moved from defining products to building them, transitioning into mobile software engineering with Flutter and Dart. I also completed an MSc in Big Data & Advanced Analytics at SGH Warsaw School of Economics.

Today, I'm taking that journey further into agentic engineering. I build and orchestrate teams of AI agents, experiment with self-hosted infrastructure like Hermes, and develop products that turn AI into practical solutions.

I built FotoReady, helping small sellers in Mexico transform a single product photo into marketplace-ready images, and founded Adoptsi (https://adoptsi.si), focused on bringing AI agents and automation to traditional businesses.

What drives me: building AI systems that are reliable, testable, and affordable enough to solve real-world problems every day.

## Experience

### Procter & Gamble — Warsaw, Poland (2023 - Present)

**Software Engineer – Mobile (Flutter/Dart)**, 2025 - Present
- Build and maintain mobile app features with Flutter and Dart.
- Write and review code, tests and technical designs with the engineering team.
- Integrate the app with backend APIs and work on reliability and performance.

**Product Manager**, 2023 - 2025
- Defined the multi-year global CRM Product Vision for Pampers and converted it into a technical roadmap for Braze/Segment integration to improve lifecycle orchestration and CLTV outcomes.
- Owned the yearly messaging vision budget for Pampers, aligning investment decisions with roadmap priorities, delivery capacity, and expected ROI.
- Led the proof of concept for API campaign automation, laying the foundations for an agentic-agency operating model and faster campaign execution.
- Engineered scalable event ingestion and API architecture, reducing API load by 1,200 bps and improving platform reliability for millions of global users.
- Established global standards for data governance, retention logic, and campaign measurement, improving campaign creation speed by 1,000 bps.
- Media Optimization: led predictive scoring initiatives and real-time Power BI/GCP dashboards that improved media investment decisions and increased incremental ROAS by 10% on the annual media spend budget.
- Unified cross-region analytics workflows into one reporting model, improving metric transparency and prioritization speed.
- Orchestrated multi-market requirements for an MVP campaign-management in-housing transformation.
